result:
Done. All 9 tests pass (`all tests passed`), and a manual smoke test confirmed flag parity (`--dest=`/`--keep=`/`-n`/`-q`/`-h`, unknown-option and bad-value exits, rc=2 for missing dir) plus that rotation now removes the oldest archives and their sidecars, and `shasum -c` agrees with `verify.sh` on a space-named archive.

Details:
- `rotate.sh`: surplus was `tail -n +KEEP` (kept lines *from* the KEEP-th, deleting the newest when total==keep); now `head -n TOTAL-KEEP`, with the early exit widened to `-le`. Also sources `lib/common.sh`.
- `verify.sh`: sidecar parsing now splits the digest off the first blank run and keeps the rest of the line as the file name (spaces intact), and the digest comparison is quoted `[[ ]]`. Also sources `lib/common.sh`.
- `lib/common.sh`: new — the shared option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `KEEP` validation, and `resolve_dir`, with the existing per-script `usage`/`parse_local_option` contract.
- `tests/run_tests.sh`: added a test for exactly-N archives with `--keep N` (deletes nothing) plus oldest-goes-newest-stays, and a test for a `my backup-…tar.gz` archive verifying `ok` with rc=0.
- `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh`: untouched (their inline parser copies remain).

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.

One note: my smoke-test fixtures under `/tmp/ftsmoke` couldn't be auto-deleted (sandbox approval prompt), so they remain at `/tmp/ftsmoke` and `/tmp/ftsmoke_smoke.sh` if you want to remove them.
